empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

stats.noAgents: No agent links this skill yet.
stats.caveat: Findings from runs where this skill was part of the prompt. An agent's other skills shared those runs — this is not a per-skill attribution.

empty.title: No runs with this skill yet
empty.body: Stats appear after an agent with this skill enabled completes a run.

add.title: Add a skill
add.subtitle: Create one by hand or import a .md file or .zip archive
add.name: Name
add.descriptionHint: Write it as an instruction to the agent: when does this skill apply?
add.fileHint: Nothing is saved until you confirm the preview.

preview.title: Import preview
preview.ignoredNote: Listed only — not imported, not executed.
preview.updateExisting: Update the existing skill with a new version instead
preview.disabledNotice: The imported skill is saved disabled — vet it, then enable it by hand.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: Write it as an instruction to the agent: when does this skill apply? This is the interface other agents see.
config.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
config.confirmDelete: Delete skill "{name}"? Agents using it will lose it.
config.messageHint: Required. Describe what you changed and why — it labels this version in the history.
config.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Tighten the auth check wording

previewTab.empty: This skill has no body yet.

versions.title: Version history
versions.empty: No earlier versions yet. A new version is created whenever the body changes.
versions.diffTitle: Changes from v{version} to the current body
